payload.notes:
RTA is now included in plsDontProc, with saved configurations linked to each monster's name and ID.

- Choose whether ally set bonuses count toward search filters. Team Builder enables this by default; RTA requires each monster to meet its own filters by default.
- Open Help directly from the Team Builder and RTA headers, with dedicated guides and an explanation of optimization priorities.
- Updated "I don't trust this app" information explains local SWEX processing, offline use, and optional file obfuscation. The MIT license applies only to the separate privacy scripts, not the application.
- The standalone privacy tools now use the chosen account name for JSON copies, handle battle/conversion events correctly, and skip obsolete FullLogger history when starting synchronization. Updated scripts: https://github.com/Extarzan/plsDontProc-Scripts
- Updated Patreon link and clearer update controls.

Account data and saved configurations are preserved when updating.
